item.title: Unraveling the mysteries of habit formation
item.description:
📝 With this two-stage training approach, the researchers were able to assess the transition from goal-directed to habitual behavior in the brains of individual mice. The team discovered that two distinct neural circuits manage completely different aspects of habits. In particular, the team demonstrated that even after a habit successfully forms, there are significant individual differences in the frequency and volume of that behavior.
🔗 Read more: https://www.kyoto-u.ac.jp/en/research-news/2026-07-28
